picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award puts Brookhaven National Laboratory at the center of building a national AI foundation model for the electric grid — a flagship example of federal AI investment in critical infrastructure, with Stony Brook as academic partner.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant (part of a $60M package) to bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a concrete, large-scale example of AI delivering real-world humanitarian and economic impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for a DOE-negotiated 'Mine of the Future' award signals growing federal interest in applying AI to domestic critical-minerals and mining infrastructure, a strategic national priority.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's laser-based 'biodynamic imaging' system uses AI to personalize chemotherapy drug selection by directly assessing individual tumor response — a genuine precision-oncology breakthrough with direct clinical translation potential.
picks.title: Lasers, Doppler effect personalize chemotherapy drug selection for cancer tumors

picks.editorial_note: King's College London researchers found that AI trained on 'dark genome' viral remnant signatures can improve prediction of chemotherapy response, opening a novel genomic avenue for personalized cancer treatment.
picks.title: Ancient viral remnants in our genome may help predict response to chemotherapy | King's College London

picks.editorial_note: UAB's foundation-model approach combining electronic health records and RNA sequencing to predict cancer treatment response represents meaningful progress toward AI-driven precision oncology.
picks.title: How one researcher is working toward AI use for cancer patient treatment

picks.editorial_note: A $1.26M NIH grant funds University of Houston chemists combining AlphaFold AI screening with quantum sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs — a novel fusion of AI and physical sensing tackling a major public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's AI 'digital human' avatar for early dementia detection won a national design award, demonstrating a deployable clinical tool with real diagnostic impact for an aging population.
picks.title: AI-powered early dementia-detection tool earns Texas A&M a Fast Company Innovation by Design Award – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn's DeepGI AI system for colonoscopy-based colorectal cancer screening earned a national public-sector excellence award, evidencing real clinical adoption of AI diagnostic tools in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: Chula Medical Innovation Receives Excellence Award 2026 - Chulalongkorn University

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot making AI data center GPU workloads dynamically shiftable to ease grid strain directly addresses one of the biggest emerging tensions around AI infrastructure — its ballooning energy demand.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets
